_comment: E2E / Testing environment — isolated SQLite DB + agent working dirs so the test suite never touches the real ./projects or koboldlair.db. The DB resolves to ./projects-test/koboldlair-test.db (ResolveSqLitePath = ProjectsPath/SqLitePath). Activate with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Testing (the '(Testing)' launch profile, or `dotnet run --project DraCode.KoboldLair.Server` with that env var). See ../DraCode.KoboldLair.Client/tests/ui-e2e/README.md.
